patch_description: The current CRY-based variant regressed performance (0.59 combined score, worse validation accuracy and larger generalization gap) compared to the earlier CRZ-based seed that scored 0.63. This edit reverts the controlled-rotation block back to the higher-performing all-CRZ design (with per-pair CRZ params matching the 0.63 seed) and applies the recommended symmetry-driven parameter merge: collapsing `crz_9` (wires [4,8]) into `crz_5` (wires [3,5]) and `crz_11` (wires [6,7]) into `crz_10` (wires [5,7]). This preserves the leaf-pair symmetry pattern already used for crz_2, crz_3, and crz_4, further reducing parameter count from 162 to 160 while keeping depth and gate count identical to the 0.63 seed, testing whether tighter parameter sharing maintains or improves the validation/generalization tradeoff.
